_ghi_chu: Danh sach trang NHAN engine tu thu muc nay khi chay `python sync.py`.
Chi them ten thu muc vao 'dich' khi trang do da san sang dung engine v2.
dang giu ban engine v1 cua rieng chung — CO Y de nguyen, chua dong bo.
Muon dong bo chung: them ten vao 'dich' roi mo lai tung lab de kiem tra.
Engine trang DOC BAI GIANG (app.js + app.css): nap muc luc va tung bai tu API
/courses/<khoaHoc>/… thay vi assets/content.js. Nguon that: engine/app.js, engine/app.css.
khoa-hoc = thu vien / trang doc CHUNG cho moi khoa trong database (?khoa=<slug>).
hien-thi.js + hien-thi.css = dung bai tu markdown, DUNG CHUNG voi khung xem truoc cua trang quan ly.
Trang Quan ly khoa hoc dung CUNG bo dung bai voi trang doc, de ban xem truoc giong het bai that.
Doc offline + cai thanh ung dung: pwa.js (dang ky worker, nut cai, bao mat mang) vao assets/.
sw.js vao GOC trang: pham vi mac dinh cua service worker la thu muc chua no,
dat trong assets/ thi worker khong dieu khien duoc trang.
Khach goi tinh nang AI (/ai/status, /ai/session, header nhan dien) — chung cho tro giang
cua trang khoa hoc (mo-ai.js) va cham bai noi OPIc.
Nut 'Thuc hanh' / 'Mo phong' o dau moi bai giang + o trang chu (mo-lien-ket.js).
Chi trang nao khai bao `lienKet` trong cau-hinh.js va them 'mo-lien-ket' vao `moDun` moi dung.
